guide.quote: Make one chosen act specific: when will you do it, how small can the first step be, and what support or resources does it need? A brief rehearsal may help with a predictable difficult moment.

rows.label: P5 · yours
rows.article: After the day, look at what actually happened.

guide.quote: Afterward, review what actually happened. Not doing it may reflect fear, uncertainty about the goal, lack of skill, exhaustion, or a practical barrier; don’t decide which without looking. Completing it without immediate relief is not automatically failure, and completion alone does not prove it helped. Adjust the action to what it actually contributes to safety, connection, competence, or enjoyment—not just to whether it earns a tick.
